pending.title: Not connected to live data yet
pending.B3: This screen shows wallet balances and top-ups, which arrive with the wallet and ledger.
pending.B4: This screen shows fuelings, alerts and their totals, which arrive with the fueling engine.
pending.B5: This screen shows device sync, which arrives with offline sync.
pending.B6: This screen shows station settlements, requests and the audit view, which arrive with station finance.

common.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log with your name.
common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it.
common.secretOnceHint: Write it down or copy it now. It can't be shown again; a new one can only replace it.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The server can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: It no longer exists, or your account can't see it.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.TAX_ID_IN_USE: Another organisation already has this tax ID.
errors.DEPARTMENT_EXISTS: This company already has a department with this name.
errors.DEPARTMENT_NOT_FOUND: Choose a department of this company.
errors.PLATE_IN_USE: Another vehicle already has this plate.
errors.INVALID_PLATE: Enter the plate's letters and digits.
errors.VIP_CEILING_ONLY_FOR_VIP: A monthly ceiling applies to VIP vehicles only.
errors.VEHICLE_DECOMMISSIONED: This vehicle is decommissioned and can't change.
errors.INVALID_TAG_UID: A tag UID is 8 to 32 hexadecimal characters (0–9, A–F).
errors.TAG_ALREADY_BOUND: This tag has been used before. A tag can be bound only once.
errors.VEHICLE_HAS_ACTIVE_TAG: This vehicle already has an active tag. Report it lost, stolen or for replacement first.
errors.INVALID_TAG_TRANSITION: This tag can't change to that status.
errors.INCOMPLETE_LOCATION: Give both latitude and longitude, or neither.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_PENDING: Only a device waiting for activation gets a new code. Revoke it and register a new one instead.
errors.PRICE_BACKDATED: A price can't start in the past.
errors.PRICE_TOO_FAR_AHEAD: Schedule at most a year ahead.
errors.PRICE_EXISTS: A price for this fuel and place already starts at that time.
errors.CONCURRENT_CHANGE: Someone else changed this at the same moment. Try again.
errors.SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: That company or operator doesn't exist.
errors.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in pounds, with up to two decimals.
errors.invalidVolume: Enter litres, with up to three decimals.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Fleet companies on ZAWED. Open one to manage its departments, vehicles and tags.
companies.search: Search by name or tax ID
companies.emptyHint: Onboard the first fleet company to start.
companies.noResultsHint: Try another name or clear the filter.

companyForm.lowBalanceHint: The company is alerted when its wallet falls below this.
companyForm.cooldownHint: From 120 to 240 minutes. 180 if left empty.

company.freezeHint: A frozen company's vehicles can't fuel until it is unfrozen.
company.frozenBannerHint: Its vehicles can't fuel until Operations unfreezes it.
company.policyHint: Only a Super Admin can change these, with a reason kept in the audit log.
company.budgetHint: For monitoring only; a budget never blocks a fueling.
company.noVehiclesHint: Add the company's first vehicle, then issue its RFID tag.

vehicleForm.plateHint: Exactly as registered. Spaces and Arabic or Western digits are all fine.
vehicleForm.vipCeilingHint: Raises a flag for Operations when passed. It never blocks a fueling and the company never sees it.

vehicle.suspendHint: A suspended vehicle can't fuel until it is reactivated.
vehicle.reactivateHint: The vehicle can fuel again with its active tag.
vehicle.decommissionHint: Final. Its tags are deactivated, its limits retired and its plate freed for another vehicle.
vehicle.decommissionedBannerHint: It is kept for history and can't change.
vehicle.issueTagHint: Scan the tag or type its UID: 8 to 32 hexadecimal characters. Spaces and colons are fine.
vehicle.noTagsHint: Issue a tag so this vehicle can fuel.
vehicle.tagFinalHint: Final: this tag can never be used again, on this vehicle or any other.
vehicle.tagReplacementHint: The tag stops working now. Issuing the new tag closes this one and keeps the vehicle's cooldown.
vehicle.tagReactivateHint: Cancels the replacement: the tag works again.
vehicle.limitHint: Replaces the current limit for the same kind and period.
vehicle.removeLimitHint: The vehicle will no longer be limited for this kind and period.
vehicle.noLimitsHint: Without limits, only the cooldown and the wallet stop a fueling.

stations.title: Stations
stations.description: The station network and the operators who run it. Open one to manage its devices and agents.
stations.emptyHint: Add the first station of an operator to start.
stations.noResultsHint: Try another name or clear the filter.

stationForm.invalidCoordinate: Enter a decimal number from -{{max}} to {{max}}.
stationForm.connectivityHint: Low means the station often loses its connection, so its devices sync less often.

station.closedBannerHint: It is kept for history and can no longer change.
station.suspendedBannerHint: Its devices can not fuel vehicles until it is reactivated.
station.suspendHint: A suspended station can not fuel vehicles until it is reactivated.
station.reactivateHint: The station can fuel vehicles again.
station.closeHint: Final. A closed station can never be reopened or changed. Its history stays.

operators.title: Operators
operators.search: Search by name or tax ID
operators.emptyHint: Register the first station operator to start.
operators.noResultsHint: Try another name or clear the filter.

operator.suspendedBannerHint: Its stations can not fuel vehicles until Operations reactivates it.
operator.suspendHint: None of this operator’s stations can fuel vehicles until it is reactivated.
operator.reactivateHint: Its stations can fuel vehicles again.

devices.title: POS devices
devices.registerHint: The device gets a code that is shown on the POS. The activation code is shown once, after you register it.
devices.label: Label
devices.labelHint: For example "Pump 3". Helps your team tell devices apart.
devices.activationHint: Enter this code on the device to activate it. It expires if not used in time.
devices.emptyHint: Register the POS device this station will use.
devices.newCodeConfirm: Create a new activation code for device {{code}}?
devices.revokeHint: Final. The device stops working now and can not be activated again. Register a new device instead.
devices.pageDescription: Every POS device on the network. Open a station to register or revoke its devices.
devices.pageEmptyHint: Devices appear here once they are registered on a station.

agents.title: Agents
agents.addHint: The agent gets a worker ID and a PIN. The PIN is shown once, and the agent must change it at first sign-in.
agents.pinHint: Give the worker ID and this PIN to the agent. They choose their own PIN at first sign-in.
agents.mustChangePin: Has not set their own PIN yet
agents.emptyHint: Add the people who fuel vehicles at this station.
agents.resetPinHint: The old PIN stops working and the agent must choose a new one at next sign-in.
agents.resetPinConfirm: Create a new PIN for worker {{workerId}}?
agents.suspendHint: A suspended agent can not sign in until reactivated.
agents.reactivateHint: The agent can sign in again.
agents.deactivateHint: Final. The agent can never sign in again. Their history stays.

prices.title: Fuel prices
prices.description: The price per litre every station charges. A price is never edited: schedule a new one instead.
prices.scheduleHint: A price is never edited and never starts in the past. Leave the start empty to start now.
prices.invalidPrice: Enter a price above zero, with up to two decimals.
prices.startHint: Cairo time on your device. Empty means now.
prices.invalidStart: Enter a valid date and time.
prices.noneNowHint: Schedule the first national price for each fuel.
prices.emptyHint: Scheduled and past prices appear here.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Your company’s vehicles. To change one, send a request to ZAWED.
vehicles.noResultsHint: Try another plate or clear the filter.
vehicles.emptyHint: ZAWED adds your vehicles when your company is onboarded.

vehicle.noTagsHint: This vehicle can fuel once ZAWED issues its RFID tag.

network.title: Network
network.description: Your stations, their POS devices and agents. Changes go through ZAWED Operations.
network.noStationsHint: Stations appear here once Operations adds them.
network.noDevicesHint: Devices appear here once Operations registers them.
network.noAgentsHint: Agents appear here once Operations adds them.
